details.description: Kiwi wax polish for leather shoes is a great way to give your shoes a quick and long-lasting shine. Made with high-quality waxes, the shoe polish helps restore and renew your leather shoes. It lends a glossy shine while protecting your favourite pairs from dirt and dust, extending the life of the leather. For best results, use the black wax polish with the Kiwi 2-in-1 shoe brush for leather shoes.
details.usageInstructions:
(1) Wipe any dirt off the shoes with a cloth.
(2) Apply polish uniformly with a cloth or polish applicator.
(3) Buff until it reaches a glossy finish.
details.manufacturerName: S C Johnson Products Private Limited

details.description: Renews and protects leather. Contains a blend of quality wax that nourishes leather and produces a long-lasting glossy shine. Provides superior staining and scuff coverage.

Kiwi instant liquid shoe polish has a blend of high-quality waxes, that makes your shoes shine instantly. Its rich wax formula provides colour protection and protects against water, enhancing the life of your leather footwear. The Kiwi instant shoe polish has been designed ergonomically to provide easy use. Its angular neck design makes reaching every corner of your shoe convenient, while the unique double-layer applicator helps control the amount of product that flows out in every usage.
details.usageInstructions:
(1) Wipe any dirt off the shoes with a cloth.
(2) Shake the bottle with the cap on before use, remove the cap and press the applicator down to apply polish with the sponge evenly over a shoe or in areas desired.
(3) Close the cap to keep the sponge soft for future use.
details.manufacturerName: S C Johnson Products Pvt. Ltd

details.description: Easy to use liquid wax polish. Concentrated formula, wax-rich formulation to nourish & protect leather. Unique long-lasting two-layer sponge with a controlled dosage.
details.usageInstructions:
1. Shake the bottle.
2. Remove cap, press cap down to apply.

details.description: Removes clogs, blockages in washbasins, septic tank, sinks, pipes in just 10 minutes. Cleaning blocked drains is easy and quick with the expert Dranex, India's No.1 Drain Expert. Its powerful formula clears heavy drain blockages in just 30 minutes. The drain cleaner works by melting grease, dirt, hair and food particles in kitchen, bathroom, balcony drains, sinks, and washbasins. Regular usage of Dranex can help prevent drain clogging and can help keep away cockroaches.
details.usageInstructions:
Remove excess water from the blocked kitchen sink, wash basin, or tub.
Empty the entire contents of 50g pouch into the drain, add a cup of water, and leave for 30 minutes.
Flush well with water.
Repeat application for stubborn blocks.
Use regularly for trouble-free drains.
